College.lesson: When the model's total is 3+ points above Vegas's, the over has tended to hit.
College.evidence: 9 graded games had a model total 3+ above Vegas. The over won in 7 (Akron, Buffalo, Charlotte, Rutgers, Ball State, Pitt, Washington) and lost in 2 (Florida, LSU).
College.test: On past seasons, group games by model total minus Vegas total (0-3, 3-6, 6+) and check how often the over hits in each group. Need 20+ games per group.

College.lesson: Big misses often come from turnovers and finishing drives, which are hard to predict.
College.evidence: 6 reviewed games missed by 8+ points. 3 of them (Memphis, Texas State, East Carolina) had turnovers or drive finishing as a top reason.
College.test: On past seasons, compare model error with turnover margin and points per trip inside the 40. Check whether the misses are random or lean one way.

College.lesson: When the model picks a different favorite than Vegas, it has not done well yet.
College.evidence: 3 recent games had a different favorite. The model was right in 1 (Missouri State) and wrong in 2 (Cincinnati, Old Dominion). Sample is tiny.
College.test: On past seasons, list games where the model and Vegas disagree on the winner, then compare the model's win rate with Vegas's. Need 20+ games.
